summary: Frontend retest of /pricing card price visibility fix (iteration_4). ALL prices at ALL requested viewports (1024, 1280, 1440, 820, 390) now render with >=15px breathing room. Fix is verified WORKING. Regression checks (MOST POPULAR badge, CTA alignment, uniform width, FAQ accordion, console errors) all pass.

detailed_measurements.method: Measured each price element's real text width by summing scrollWidth of each child span (£ prefix + numeric span, OR just 'Custom' span) plus gap-1 (4px). Content width = inner card innerWidth minus computed padding-left minus computed padding-right. Breathing room = contentWidth - requiredWidth. This avoids the false-negative from measuring the flex wrapper's own width.

viewport_1024x900.verdict: PASS at 1024 (tightest case, still >=15px for every card)

regression_checks.most_popular_badge_visible_on_growth: PASS at all 5 viewports (badge element rendered, non-zero size, text='Most Popular')
regression_checks.cta_uniform_width: PASS - all 4 CTAs width=260px at 1440, 292px at 390 (matching)
regression_checks.cta_bottom_alignment_desktop: PASS - all 4 CTAs share the same bottom coordinate at 1440 (bottom=6)
regression_checks.faq_accordion_toggle: PASS - aria-expanded transitions from true to false on click
regression_checks.console_errors: 0 errors captured during full test run

critical_code_review_comments: PricingCards.jsx: fix is effective. Numeric price lg:text-[40px] xl:text-[52px] 2xl:text-[60px] plus reduced £ prefix (lg:text-lg) plus reduced inner card padding (lg:p-6) collectively give >=25px breathing room at the tightest viewport (1024).

Recommendation (non-blocking): consider adding a runtime dev-only warning or visual test that measures scrollWidth vs contentWidth so future font/padding changes don't silently reintroduce clipping (overflow-hidden on inner card would hide it).
Iteration_3 measurement used getBoundingClientRect on a clipped element; iteration_4 measurement using per-child scrollWidth is the correct method and should be preserved in future regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 viewports pass, 20/20 price cells >=15px breathing room)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified. If further changes are made to PricingCards.jsx font sizes or padding, re-run the same measurement approach: for each card, sum scrollWidth of children in div.flex.items-baseline plus 4px gap per child gap, compare to (innerRect.width - computedPaddingLeft - computedPaddingRight). Requirement is >=15px. Viewports to check: 1024, 1280, 1440, 820, 390.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iterations 2 and 3 failed at 1024/1280 because font sizes at lg/xl were too large relative to the narrow 4-column card content widths (~150-214px). The iteration_4 fix reduced lg numeric to text-[40px], lg Custom to text-[36px], lg £ prefix to text-lg, AND reduced lg padding from p-8 to p-6, yielding 166px content width at 1024 and 25-98px breathing room for all 4 cards. Also reduced xl sizes symmetrically. Verified at 1024, 1280, 1440, 820, 390 — all pass.
